evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples.
